globalPromptFragments.optics: Cinematic large-format look, shallow depth of field, subtle edge chromatic aberration, faint bloom on emissive surfaces only, fine film grain, photographic contrast with a true black point.

phase1.objective: The single most important image in the system: NEVAMIS resolving out of the dark as a lattice that catches what was falling. NEVAMIS is the structure, never an object.
phase1.modelReason: Cinematic stills at up to 4K; camera and colour character matter more than character consistency, and no subject identity is involved.
phase1.prompt: A vast dark architectural interior. Emerging from the blackness below, a precise violet lattice of light resolves into view — an ordered geometric plane spanning the entire volume, as though it was always present and the light has only now reached it. Above it, small luminous electric-blue rectangular data objects descend and come to rest on the lattice instead of falling past it. The lattice is structure, not an object: no housing, no device, no glowing box. Brushed graphite architecture, volumetric beams with real body, glass edge caustics on the blue objects. Cinematic large-format look, shallow depth of field, faint bloom on emissive surfaces only, fine film grain, true black point.
phase1.negativeInPrompt: no people, no faces, no hands, no robots, no text, no lettering, no logos, no circuit board patterns, no wireframe globe, no neon signage, no HUD, no glass spheres, no blobs, no server racks, no lens flare
phase1.finalUse: Website section image + start frame for the C04 video in Phase 3.

phase1.objective: A captured call opening into layered glass panels of structured information. This is the shot that proves the product is a product.
phase1.modelReason: Highest photoreal material quality; glass refraction and layered depth are the whole point of this frame.
phase1.prompt: A single luminous electric-blue data object at rest, opening into three or four layered panes of thick refractive glass suspended in a dark architectural void. Each pane is a clean empty surface catching light — no writing on any of them. The panes are separated in depth so the rear ones refract through the front ones, with visible edge caustics and soft internal reflections. Cool blue key light from the object itself, violet rim light from far behind, deep graphite surroundings. Cinematic large-format, very shallow depth of field, faint bloom, fine grain, true black point.
phase1.negativeInPrompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no UI labels, no icons, no people, no faces, no hands, no robots, no logos, no circuit patterns, no HUD, no neon, no spheres, no blobs, no lens flare
phase1.criticalNote: Panes MUST be empty. All type is composited in post from the real product's typefaces — a generated label is gibberish and gibberish in a product shot is a lie about the product.
phase1.finalUse: Website 'interactive workflow' section + start frame for C07.

phase1.objective: The platform image: one flow revealed as one strand among many across an entire architecture.
phase1.prompt: An extreme wide view of an enormous dark architectural structure built from tiers of violet light-paths, seen from a high vantage. Many parallel routes run through it carrying small blue luminous objects. One single route is brighter than the rest and traced in pale mint-green, running the full depth of the structure. The remaining routes are drawn but unlit, present yet dormant. Immense sense of scale and quiet order. Graphite and dark metal surfaces, volumetric haze, cinematic large-format, shallow depth of field, faint bloom on emissive elements only, fine grain, true black point.
phase1.negativeInPrompt: no people, no faces, no city skyline, no cyberpunk, no text, no lettering, no logos, no circuit board, no wireframe globe, no neon signage, no HUD, no spheres, no blobs, no lens flare
phase1.finalUse: Website 'operating layer' section + start frame for C10.

phase1.objective: Seamless 8-second homepage hero: the lattice extending, and one call arriving and coming to rest on it. Must loop invisibly and read at 390px wide.
phase1.modelReason: Takes start_image AND end_image, which is the only reliable way to make a clip whose last frame matches its first.
phase1.endImage: same frame, regenerated with the arriving object removed — so the loop closes
phase1.prompt: Slow lateral camera track across a vast dark architectural interior. A precise violet lattice of light extends smoothly across the volume. A single luminous electric-blue data object enters from frame right, travels along the lattice, and comes gently to rest. Continuous unbroken motion, no cuts. Volumetric light, glass edge caustics, cinematic large-format, shallow depth of field, fine grain, true black point.
phase1.negativeInPrompt: no people, no faces, no hands, no text, no logos, no cuts, no camera shake, no zoom, no flashing, no strobing, no circuit patterns, no HUD, no neon
phase1.estimatedCredits: 54, plus 54 if a retry is needed
phase1.loopRule: If the cycle point is visible, reject. A loop that visibly restarts is worse than no loop.

phase1.objective: A materials and lighting plate: the exact glass, graphite and volumetric-light character every later shot is matched against. Generated once, referenced thereafter.
phase1.prompt: A study of materials in a dark architectural space: a thick slab of refractive glass edge-lit in electric blue resting on brushed graphite, with a violet volumetric beam crossing behind it. No subject, no product, no figure — purely surface, light and depth. Cinematic large-format, macro detail on the glass edge caustics, shallow depth of field, fine grain, true black point.
phase1.negativeInPrompt: no people, no text, no logos, no product, no device, no robots, no neon, no circuit patterns
phase1.finalUse: Reference image passed to every subsequent generation to hold the look together.
